resources.string:
Android: 64-bit ARM devices running Android 14 or newer. Tested on the Galaxy S26 Ultra (SM-S948U). Other devices are not yet verified.

Installable: iOS 14.0 beta 5 (18A5351d), using CPU emulation. SpringBoard, touch, Home, repeat boot and saved appearance have been demonstrated. First installation downloads about 5.5 GB; allow at least 20 GB free.

Experimental: GLES and Metal on prepared iOS 14 guests. Metal testing covers linked demonstration apps on Adreno; it does not establish general app or game compatibility. GPU guest preparation is not automatic.

Not ready: general iOS 16.5 use, CPU hardware virtualization on the tested phone, or a 60 FPS guarantee.

Android stays installed. iOS images and SEP ROM are obtained separately by the preparation process; they are not bundled in this APK.
